name: Aisha Wahab

items.why: Authoring a civil-rights bill that the governor vetoed as unnecessary, and then facing failed recall drives, is ordinary legislative work and a policy dispute, with no finding of wrongdoing under criteria 1 to 6, and the platform score covers her stances.

for_review: I read only search-result excerpts, not full pages. These covered LAist, CalMatters, SF Chronicle, San José Spotlight and Wahab's own press statement. The LAist page I tried to open came back truncated. The excerpts show that Newsom vetoed SB 403 on Oct. 7, 2023, saying caste bias is already barred. They also show that critics said it singled out Hindus and that the recall drive failed in 2024 over a petition flaw. I found no allegation of abuse of office, self-dealing or false statements about her record. The item says four recall attempts, but the reporting I saw describes about three and says nothing about 'four'. The search for the owner's named sites with her name found nothing relevant. Attendance and AIPAC matters are handled in separate steps. I searched this one item only, so check whether other controversies exist, such as campaign finance filings, her time as a Hayward council member, or her House votes.
